title: JACKAL agent profile v1
description: Immutable declaration of the JACKAL tool surface an agent host may expose. A profile is a name list and nothing more: it grants no capability, performs no computation, and can never raise an assurance class. The engine remains the only authority for calculation, routing, assurance, and refusal.

profile_id.description: Profile identity; must equal the file stem.

description.description: Operator-readable justification for the exact tool set, including why each admitted lane belongs in this profile.

tools.description: Tool names, each of which must exist in plugin/hermes/tools.json, listed in tools.json declaration order.

immutable.description: Mutation lock. Shipped profiles are always true; the verifier refuses a shipped profile that declares false.

profile_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON encoding (sorted keys, separators (",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) of this object with profile_digest_sha256 omitted.
